title: Double Ring Ceremony Unites Savoy Couple
text:
MRS. H. F. BOMAR, JR.

Double Ring Ceremony Unites Savoy Couple

SAVOY.—Miss Cecil Inez Bibby and H. F. Bomar, Jr., were married Sunday afternoon at 4 o'clock at the home of Mr. and Mrs. Otis Baker. The Rev. Evert Springfield, pastor of the Baptist Church, read the double ring ceremony.

The bride is the daughter of Mr. and Mrs. B. P. Bibby, of Savoy and the groom is the son of Mr. and Mrs. H. F. Bomar, also of Savoy.

The pre-nuptial music was by Mrs. G. N. Morgan and Mrs. Gene Hardy of Bonham sang "I Love You Truly."

The vows were exchanged before an altar of palms, white gladioli and magnolia blossoms, with white candles in candelabra on each side. Miss Carolyn Brown lighted the candles.

The bride wore a pink eyelet dress and her only jewelry was a lavalier belonging to her mother.

A reception at the Baker home followed the ceremony.

Mrs. Bomar is a 1946 graduate of Savoy High School, where she was valedictorian of her class and voted sweetheart of the football team.

Mr. Bomar also graduated from Savoy High School. He received his Army discharge last April, following four years' service, 18 months of which were spent overseas. The couple will make their home in Savoy.
